content:
oncall-bot: Paging: SLO alert: streaming.p99 > 7500ms for the last 5m (route: /v1/stream/generate). Suspected rollout change: quant-profile-int8-regen (deployed ~10:05 UTC). Auto-page to #incidents and oncall. :rotating_light:

emily (oncall): seeing it in the console too. p95 ~1200ms, p99 spiking 8s+. Customers with streaming-heavy workloads show increased client-side retries. Reassigning to eng-runtime + SRE.

harper (sre): I'm on the graphs. KV cache/eviction looks fine. There are bursts of long tail exclusively on nodes in us-west-2a. CPU on those GPUs is normal, but batch sizes are smaller and token time jumps.

raj (eng-runtime): thanks. this aligns with the int8 precision profile rollout we pushed at 10:05 (canary -> 50%). Rolling back profile to previous stable set now.

maria (eng-ml): quick note: the int8 regen included a new per-layer scaling tweak that reduced dynamic range — could cause dequantization overhead on long contexts.

emily (oncall): harper can you confirm which machines are failing? list?

harper (sre): affected nodes: infer-uw2a-{12,13,14,21}. I'll cordon 12 and 13 for diagnostics, leave 14 serving so we don't lose capacity completely.

ops-bot: Command executed by harper: `cordon infer-uw2a-12 && cordon infer-uw2a-13`

raj (eng-runtime): starting configuration rollback for quant-profile-int8-regen -> quant-profile-int8-v2 (previous). Patch request to rollout service:
```
POST /platform/rollouts/revert
{
  "rollout_id": "r-2026-10-05-quant-int8-regen",
  "target_profile": "quant-profile-int8-v2",
  "strategy": "immediate"
}
```
Initiated at 10:18 UTC. ETA for config propagate ~60-90s.

emily (oncall): jonathan, please capture customer impacts and open tickets for top affected orgs. Which customers are hitting errors?

jonathan (support): listing now. Top impacted customers by request rate: AcmeMedia (5% of their calls timed out), Learnly (inc. 12% retries on long-streams), and internal test traffic. I've DM'd CSMs for AcmeMedia and Learnly to let them know we're investigating.

maria (eng-ml): if rollback doesn't reduce tail, we should disable int8 for long-context routes only. We can push a route-level override to force fp16 for /v1/stream/generate heavy flows.

harper (sre): rollback started propagating. I'm seeing p99 drop from 8s -> 3.1s within 90s for most nodes. Good sign.

emily (oncall): realtime timeline: alert at 10:15; rollback started 10:18; p99 trending down by 10:20. Still seeing a couple of sporadic spikes.

raj (eng-runtime): toggled route override to prefer fp16 for the streaming model for requests > 1024 tokens. Command:
```
PATCH /routing/overrides
{
  "route": "/v1/stream/generate",
  "condition": "context_length > 1024",
  "force_precision": "fp16"
}
```
Applied 10:22 UTC.

harper (sre): after override, p99 stabilized ~1.1s and p95 ~900ms across all AZs. Nodes infer-uw2a-12/13 are cordoned and not receiving traffic.

jonathan (support): customers updated: AcmeMedia and Learnly notified at 10:25 UTC with ETA for follow-up. No revenue-impacting outages reported; mostly retry increases.

maria (eng-ml): immediate mitigation looks effective. Next steps: full rollback verification + rebuild int8 profile with safer per-layer scaling, run long-context synthetic tests, then canary rollout with smaller step and longer soak.

emily (oncall): agreed. action items: (1) raj/eng-runtime: validate rollback fully and confirm no config drift (owner: raj) (2) harper/sre: remove cordon only after cold-start mitigation validated (owner: harper) (3) maria/eng-ml: reproduce in staging and prepare safer profile (owner: maria) (4) jonathan/support: follow up with customers and log incident notes (owner: jonathan).

raj (eng-runtime): confirming rollback status: rollout service reports SUCCESS at 10:26 UTC for r-2026-10-05-quant-int8-regen revert. All nodes receiving quant-profile-int8-v2 again except those cordoned.

harper (sre): I'll start uncordoning once we see sustained 10m of stable p99 < 1.5s.

ops-bot: Incident channel pinned: https://console.redwood.ai/incidents/3356789012 (autogenerated incident doc)

emily (oncall): marking this as P1 -> mitigation achieved. Moving to postmortem phase. Please add logs / timeline to incident doc with exact timestamps.

maria (eng-ml): quick note for postmortem: add regression test for per-layer scaling sensitivity and a gating eval that runs long-context prompt families on quantized profiles.

jonathan (support): I'll attach customer retry traces and user-visible error samples to the incident doc.

emily (oncall): handoff to night oncall @ 22:00 UTC: @alex (next oncall) — summary: rollback done, route override in place for >1024 tokens, p99 stabilized. Please watch for any recurrence post-uncordon.

alex (oncall): taking over at 22:00. noted.

emily (oncall): closing active page. follow-up thread for postmortem: please continue in #incidents-postmortems. :white_check_mark:
